name: Situation J — independent predictive admissibility projection
base_architecture: frozen Situation-I continuous risk governor inside frozen Situation-H hard RTA shell
projection: closed-form Euclidean projection onto the intersection of independent per-axis command, predicted relative-position, and predicted relative-velocity intervals
projection_model: constant-command relative-motion surrogate over a fixed horizon; independent of all learned weights
selected_on_validation_seeds: 8800-8819 plus fault-pilot seeds 8850-8869; not used for final claims
selection_reason: tightest validated candidate with zero projection activity and zero RMSE change on healthy nominal, wind3, and compound validation cases
proposal_fault_semantics: post-governor pre-projection command corruption; used only to test containment of a bad proposal, not to model a specific cyberattack

success_criteria.healthy_transparency: mean J-vs-I RMSE degradation <0.10% across main stressed scenarios and nominal projection activity <1%
success_criteria.projection_feasibility: main-scenario infeasible predictive boxes <0.1% of control cycles
success_criteria.fault_containment_wind_impulse: J reduces mean RMSE by >=15% vs unprojected I and mean >1m excursion fraction is no greater than I
success_criteria.fault_containment_compound_stuck: J reduces mean RMSE by >=15% vs unprojected I and mean >1m excursion fraction is no greater than I

claim_boundary: The projection is an independent predictive admissibility filter, not a formal invariant-set/CBF/reachability safety proof. It uses the benchmark state estimate and a simplified constant-command prediction model.
